h_main_editor.name: Main Editor
h_main_editor.description: Stuff that affects the main part of the editor.

ctrl_to_pan.name: CTRL to pan
ctrl_to_pan.description: Allows using the CTRL key to pan the level editor, like shift.

open_recent_button.name: Open Recent button
open_recent_button.description: Adds a button to the editor menu that opens a recent file.

num_recent_levels.name: Amount of recent levels to save
num_recent_levels.description: Saves the last X opened levels as recently opened.

hide_sidebar_arrow.name: Hide sidebar button
hide_sidebar_arrow.description: Adds a button to the editor menu that hides the sidebar.

help_tooltips.name: Help tooltips
help_tooltips.description: Adds tooltips to parts of the editor to help explain what they do.

h_playtest.name: Playtest
h_playtest.description: Stuff that affects the playtesting mode of the editor.

playtest_panning.name: Playtest panning
playtest_panning.description: Allows panning the screen while playtesting a level in the editor.

playtest_zooming.name: Playtest zooming
playtest_zooming.description: Allows zooming the screen while playtesting a level in the editor.

h_advanced.name: Advanced / Experimental
h_advanced.description: Stuff that's either fairly advanced or currently in development.

level_scripts.name: Level Scripts
level_scripts.description: ONLY USE THIS WITH LEVELS YOU TRUST! Allows levels to run custom code.
